deviations.detail: The freeze declares index columns but not index names. Laravel's generated name for the plane node parent/order index is 65 characters and exceeds the MySQL 64-character identifier limit, so every new index is named explicitly.
deviations.shape_impact: none: same columns, same uniqueness, only the identifier names are explicit
deviations.found_by: MySQL smoke; SQLite accepted the long name silently

deviations.detail: The freeze declares riskClass with a default of change. Core's older tests load contract files without the autoloader, so an enum default would break them. The parameter is nullable with a null default and effectiveRiskClass() resolves null to change.
deviations.shape_impact: none behaviourally: an undeclared risk class still counts as a non-reversible change
deviations.resolution: recorded here and in the implementation summary; the freeze text should be amended when Batch 3 introduces the registry
